//: Opt-in JS type-checking via per-file `// @ts-check` directives. The main
tsconfig.json keeps allowJs/checkJs OFF so the strict TS suite continues to
only see .ts/.tsx/.d.ts files. This config flips allowJs on so src JS files
load into the program (cross-file inference), but leaves checkJs OFF so only
files that explicitly opt in via `// @ts-check` (first lines) get checked.
noImplicitAny is ON: opted-in files must annotate every parameter (JSDoc
@param) or make it inferrable. End-state: every .js under src/ is opted in
(.jsx components are out of scope; they benefit via inference).
Coverage is ratcheted by scripts/verify-checkjs-ratchet.js — directives can
never be removed and covered directories stay at 100%. Run via
`npm run typecheck:js`; enumerate remaining files in a directory with
once a directory is fully annotated, strictNullChecks can be evaluated by
burning down per-directory. Do not flip it globally in this file until that
.jsx files are included (jsx: react) ONLY so imports from checked .js files
resolve; they carry no @ts-check and are never error-checked.
